schema_note: Additive, bounded evidence-fidelity correction to feature-engine-mutation-step9-formal-evidence-005.json, remediating ChatGPT Review A's REVISION_REQUIRED verdict (0 Blocker / 2 Major / 0 Minor, Risk R1). evidence-005.json is NOT modified -- it remains immutable, byte-unchanged (blob f7a6ab715155ad166808e0e9d9a7474196d9b69d, verified before and after this transaction). This correction does not rerun the fresh formal mutation measurement, does not redesign the timeout-triage protocol, and does not open a new remediation wave -- it corrects two evidence-fidelity defects in how evidence-005.json's own raw data was interpreted/narrated.

maj_01_remediation.defect: evidence-005.json's locked timeout-triage protocol explicitly defines: timeout+timeout -> CONFIRMED_TIMEOUT; killed+killed -> resolved killed; survived+survived -> resolved survived; any disagreement between the two independent fresh isolated reruns -> UNSTABLE_TIMEOUT_TRIAGE, and any such disagreement STOPS Condition-1 gate interpretation (no majority vote, no forced tie-break). evidence-005.json correctly found and preserved 9 UNSTABLE_TIMEOUT_TRIAGE mutants under this protocol, but its own condition_1_evaluation.result nevertheless recorded a formal 'FAIL -- criteria' verdict computed from conservative/best-case numerator bounds. That is a violation of the protocol's own STOP clause -- the protocol does not carve out an exception for 'the outcome doesn't change either way'; it requires the gate interpretation itself to halt, unconditionally, on any unresolved disagreement.
maj_01_remediation.correction: Condition-1's FORMAL state is corrected to 'STOPPED / UNRESOLVED under the locked timeout-triage protocol' -- neither PASS nor FAIL is formally declared, because 9 of the 2629 mutants (identified in evidence-005.json's timeout_triage.records as UNSTABLE_TIMEOUT_TRIAGE) remain formally unresolved and the protocol prohibits resolving them by majority vote or an unauthorized third tie-break run within this transaction. The conservative (84.21453023963484%) and best-case bound (84.55686572841384%) figures already present in evidence-005.json's raw_mutation_effectiveness_metric are NOT deleted or recomputed -- they are explicitly relabeled here as NON-FORMAL diagnostic/planning evidence, kept because they establish the mathematical fact that no resolution of the 9 unstable mutants (even the most favorable one) reaches the required 87.001959503592% threshold (best-case numerator 2223 vs. required 2288, gap 65) -- this fact is useful for future remediation planning but MUST NOT be cited as the governed Condition-1 verdict.
maj_01_remediation.corrected_condition_1_formal_state: STOPPED / UNRESOLVED — locked timeout-triage protocol's disagreement clause triggered; Condition-1 gate interpretation cannot be formally declared PASS or FAIL until the 9 UNSTABLE_TIMEOUT_TRIAGE mutants are resolved through a governed mechanism (not defined by this correction).

diagnostic_only_bounds_relabeled.label: NON-FORMAL — diagnostic/planning evidence only, NOT the governed Condition-1 verdict
diagnostic_only_bounds_relabeled.note: Mathematically, even the most favorable possible resolution of all 9 unstable mutants (all treated as killed) does not reach the threshold — this is disclosed as useful planning context, not as a substitute for the formally STOPPED gate state.

maj_02_remediation.defect: Fresh Review A reconciliation found feature_engine.identity.x_deterministic_id__mutmut_3 status regressed: evidence-004.json = 'killed', evidence-005.json = 'survived'. Production identity.py source and its only call sites (candle.py, contracts.py) are byte-identical between evidence-004.json's boundary (repository commit b3d4086033f1c232c0cd8706c9096f50b049de14) and evidence-005.json's boundary (662ed13e68838c17b290754047adb3c0cbf98f62) -- verified via `git diff` (empty) on both src/feature_engine/identity.py and the tests tree relevant to it; Waves 1-4 never touched identity.py or any identity-specific test (no tests/test_identity.py file exists in this repository). evidence-005.json's collateral_effect_vs_evidence_004 section stated still_survived_count=405 and additional_collateral_kills=0, which sums exactly to evidence-004.json's own 474-survivor baseline (405+69=474) but never explains why evidence-005.json's ACTUAL total survivor_count is 406, not 405 -- the narrative silently omitted this one killed->survived regression, which lies entirely OUTSIDE evidence-004.json's 474-survivor baseline set (it was killed there, so it was never a baseline survivor).

No dedicated tests/test_identity.py exists; deterministic_id is exercised only transitively through whichever tests happen to construct candle/fact identities.
bounded_isolated_investigation.working_hypothesis: The killed->survived transition is most plausibly attributable to mutmut's own coverage-based per-mutant test-selection being sensitive to run-to-run variance for a shared, multiply-called, indirectly-tested utility function (deterministic_id) -- i.e. which exact subset of the full test suite gets attributed as 'covering' this specific mutated line can differ between two separately-generated fresh full-population mutmut runs (evidence-004.json's own full run vs. evidence-005.json's own full run), even with byte-identical source and tests. This is NOT fully mechanistically proven within this bounded investigation's scope (that would require instrumenting mutmut's own coverage-collection internals, out of scope for a bounded single-mutant correction) -- it is disclosed as the most plausible working hypothesis, analogous in kind (though not in mechanism) to the already-documented mutant-ID IDENTITY_COLLISION_OR_SEMANTIC_DISCONTINUITY phenomenon in Condition-2's 170-identity mapping, where the same exact mutant ID string does not reliably denote the same semantic mutation/coverage-selection across separate mutmut population regenerations.
bounded_isolated_investigation.current_status_for_condition_1_purposes: survived — genuinely reproducible under the current (evidence-005.json) boundary, NOT a spurious artifact of the parallel full run (unlike the 88 raw timeout candidates); evidence-005.json's raw recording of this status is accurate and is NOT altered by this correction.

The observed delta also includes this one killed->survived regression (which removes 1 mutant from the numerator that the estimate implicitly assumed would remain killed, since the estimate = formal_numerator(2155) + 69 credited kills, with no term accounting for a possible NEW regression outside the 474-baseline). Corrected in the ledger's pointer field by this transaction (see ledger_and_docs_updates below).
maj_02_remediation.reproducible_but_bounded_stop_check: This investigation did NOT expose a deeper contradiction requiring scope expansion beyond evidence correction: the regression is a single, fully reproducible, fully explained (at working-hypothesis level) discrepancy confined to one non-credited, non-Condition-2, non-Waves-1-4-touched mutant. No STOP triggered; remediated within this bounded correction.
